source_target_name: RMA or USDA recovery and receivables materials
source_target_scope: Find whether FCIC improper-payment dollars are recorded as receivables, collections, recoveries, debts, or otherwise collectible amounts.
negative_evidence_rule: If the source only reports improper-payment estimates or root-cause categories without collectible-dollar treatment, keep field closure and scoring blocked.
public_use_rule: Use as a methodology component gate source-target row only; not a savings estimate and not a finding of waste.

source_target_scope: Find whether specific FCIC controls, data mining, compliance reviews, or corrective actions tie preventable dollars to the improper-payment estimate.
negative_evidence_rule: If the source only describes process improvements without tying dollars to preventable or recoverable amounts, keep scoring blocked.
public_use_rule: Use as a methodology component gate source-target row only; not a savings estimate and not a finding of waste.

program_or_activity: Purchased Long Term Services and Supports (PLTSS)
source_target_name: VA or VHA bills-of-collection and overpayment materials
source_target_scope: Find whether PLTSS incorrect-amount findings are converted into bills of collection, recoveries, debts, or collectible overpayment amounts.
negative_evidence_rule: If the source only reports aggregate overpayments or improper and unknown payments without a recoverable incorrect-amount subset, keep field closure and scoring blocked.
public_use_rule: Use as a methodology component gate source-target row only; not a savings estimate and not a finding of waste.

program_or_activity: Purchased Long Term Services and Supports (PLTSS)
source_target_name: VA or VHA PLTSS medical-review category materials
source_target_scope: Find whether documentation, timeliness, technical, unknown-payment, and incorrect-amount categories are separated for recoverability review.
negative_evidence_rule: If the source mixes documentation defects or unknown payments with recoverable overpayments, keep scoring blocked.
public_use_rule: Use as a methodology component gate source-target row only; not a savings estimate and not a finding of waste.

source_target_name: USDA OIG FY2024 PIIA compliance audit and same-period RMA sample disclosures
source_target_scope: Determine whether official same-period evidence supports a narrow FY2024 sampling-governance and disclosed-design component without implying full public reproducibility.
negative_evidence_rule: If the sources do not disclose frame construction, allocation, probabilities, randomization, replacement, nonresponse, weights, estimator, and variance, keep the full sample-design field open.
public_use_rule: Use as a methodology component gate source-target row only; not a full sample-design closure, not a savings estimate, and not a finding of waste.

source_target_name: FCIC/RMA FY2020 financial report historical sampling-and-estimation disclosure
source_target_scope: Capture the last located public FCIC selection-procedure disclosure and test whether it supports any same-period inference for FY2024.
negative_evidence_rule: If the disclosure is historical and no official source establishes FY2024 continuity, close only a historical-method component and keep current sample design and estimation method open.
public_use_rule: Use as a methodology component gate source-target row only; not a current-method closure, not a savings estimate, and not a finding of waste.
